summary: Flips or flops TOP axes, including X/Y image axes and Z or slice direction for 3D/array textures.

key_params.name: flop
key_params.note: Transpose/reorient mode such as noflop, bottomleft, topleft, rightbackdown, rightfrontup, backupleft, or frontupright

common_gotchas: Flip and flop are different operations; flop transposes axes.
2D flop changes output resolution orientation by swapping X and Y.
3D flop modes have orientation semantics and can remap depth into other axes.
Flip Z only matters for 3D textures or texture arrays.
key_concepts: Flip TOP flips image data horizontally, vertically, or along Z/slice direction.
Flop transposes rows and columns rather than simply mirroring an axis.
For 2D images, flop swaps X and Y resolution.
For 3D textures and 2D arrays, flop modes can remap depth into X/Y orientation.
The operator is useful for coordinate-system and capture-orientation correction.
The official TOP supports 3D textures and 2D texture arrays.
